requirements.requirement: Primary entry is a Windows desktop application with owned window controls and broker lifecycle; ordinary browser/site is not the product delivery.
requirements.acceptance: Launch current desktop app, close/reopen window without losing owned terminals, render compiled React Flow surface under real CSP; verify packaging and Windows shortcut.

requirements.requirement: Maestri-like appearance from the supplied screenshot: graphite sidebar, near-full canvas, compact floating icon toolbar, sparse chrome, real terminal nodes and curved dashed links.
requirements.acceptance: Compare captures at reference and normal desktop resolutions; inspect actual PTY nodes, sidebar, compact controls, resize and terminal readability.

requirements.requirement: Research and actually incorporate established components for the UI rather than implementing another canvas renderer from scratch.
requirements.acceptance: Pinned dependency/build manifests and runtime demonstrate React Flow primitives and actual imported controls/icons; no renderer mock substituted.

requirements.requirement: Agents receive current working goals/roles/tasks/context and autonomously create agents, teams and directed collaborations within delegated scope.
requirements.acceptance: Actual model creates a child with a specific brief; child retrieves inherited protected context and responds; team/collaboration receipts persist; replay does not launch another child or repeat handoff.

requirements.requirement: Discover other SENTRA instances on configured network/Hamachi peers using a stable common peer port, establish authenticated collaboration and permit scoped agent cooperation.
requirements.acceptance: Two configured machines on the actual Hamachi network discover and authenticate each other, exchange selected task context, collaborate through admitted local work and persist acknowledgements; unknown/expired/replayed peers cannot execute commands or acquire grants.
